title: Keep the dressiness consistent
rule: Pieces at the same level of formality look intentional.
body: Polish isn't about dressing up; it's about agreement. A casual outfit where everything is casual looks more put-together than a suit jacket over track pants.

title: Polished shoes do the heavy lifting
rule: Tailored trousers want loafers, derbies or a clean leather sneaker.
body: Shoes set the register of an outfit. Swap a running shoe for a loafer and the same trousers suddenly look deliberate and sharp.

title: Bridge smart and casual
rule: One in-between piece lets dressy and casual meet halfway.
body: Loafers with jeans, a knit with tailored trousers, a leather sneaker with a suit trouser. The bridge piece tells people the mix is on purpose.

title: Keep runners for running
rule: Running shoes pull tailoring toward the gym.
body: Technical trainers are built for sport, and they look it. With anything tailored, reach for a loafer, a derby or a minimal leather sneaker instead.
